harness: probe service (tools/stallfloor/probe.py): frozen kernel families, every thread of every launch judged against a host-computed checksum
what: the recycle of a write barrier in flight (the older load on write barrier 1, the younger load's own word waits barrier 1 and sets it again, a reader takes the OLDER load's register without a wait 1 / 2 / 4 cycles behind that word), and N = 2 / 4 / 8 shared loads of one thread in flight behind one wait with the yield flag on every load

conditions.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

provenance.dep_table_commit: c8d79a6 The sm_120 dependency table prices the upper register of an IMAD.WIDE result apart, and CS2R -> IMAD is 6: two p

classes.good: the intended values in all 256 iterations
classes.stale: raw / ord: the consumer took the register's previous content in all 256
classes.late: war: the store took the rewritten register in all 256
classes.overtake: war: the read-back saw the slot before the store in all 256

requests.pair: LDS on write barrier 1, a younger LDS whose own word WAITS barrier 1 and sets it again (the recycle of a barrier), the reader of the older load's register does NOT wait and stands 1 cycle(s) behind the younger load (distance = older -> younger; ctl = two barriers, the reader waits both)
